title: Establish native-review claim evidence through campaign terminalization

placement.claim: Accepted as the bounded pre-S14 PPCE-03/PPCE-04 product proposal for subsequent implementation planning; permanent ownership and S14 placement remain unsettled.

reopening_conditions: Implementation planning finds that PPCE-03 and PPCE-04 cannot remain one coherent selection-to-terminalization boundary.
The acceptance owner chooses or changes the normalized-admission owner, backend boundary, evidence-retention form, or claim-relative evidence profile.
Accepted S14 contracts supersede this pre-S14 placement or assign different owners.
A separately accepted bootstrap protocol identifies exact retained Claude artifacts and changes the transitional evidence boundary.
Migration audit finds another consumption boundary or incompatible historical or in-flight records.

authority.decision_owner: active operator or explicitly delegated native-review acceptance owner
